question:
The following bar chart shows the number of computers sold by a shop in 6 consecutive months.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8904cd0b5eb9667191a1b86d14967928f7e73e2bdfe3e50fff2f243b6ea30df.png] 

What is the average number of computers sold per month during this period? [Round off your answer to the nearest integer value.]
solution:
Calculation:

Now, the average number of computers sold per month during this period

⇒ (160 + 220 + 310 + 180 + 230 + 150)/6

⇒ 208.33 ≈ 208

**∴ The average number of computers sold per month during this period is 208.**
